learning_objective: 🎯 Let us discover the magic of repeating shapes and cool number sequences to become master pattern detectives!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Patterns are shapes or colors that repeat in a rule! If you see a red circle, blue square, red circle, blue square... you easily know what comes next!
Numbers can play hide-and-seek in patterns too! In the sequence 2, 4, 6, 8, the secret rule is adding 2 every time. Can you guess the next number?
When shapes fit together perfectly without any gaps or overlaps, they create a beautiful tessellation. Look at the tiles on your bathroom floor!

fun_activity.title: 🧩 Floor Tile Detective
fun_activity.instructions: Look at the floor tiles in your house. Draw the repeating pattern on a piece of paper and color it beautifully!

quick_recap: ⭐ Patterns are things that repeat following a specific rule.
⭐ Number sequences use addition, subtraction, or multiplication to grow or shrink.
⭐ Tessellations are shapes fitted together with zero gaps in between!
